title: Whale's Tail Parasail Miramar Beach
specs: Winner of WSIA Parasail Operators Award of Excellence
Minimum age to parasail is 6 years of age.

PHYSICAL RESTRICTIONS: If you are PREGNANT, have a HEART CONDITION, BAD BACK or any other physical conditions that will be aggravated by potential rough conditions on the ocean or the parasail flight.
Minimum total weight for a flight is 200 lbs. and Maximum weight is 450-500 lbs (204kg).
People who are at higher risk categories such as those over 65 years old and people of any age who have serious underlying medical conditions should not participate.
We require a child to be at least 6 years old to parasail.
The minimum combined weight in the chute at one time varies on wind conditions but will never be less than 160 pounds.
The maximum weight per flyer is 250 pounds.
A maximum number of three flyers will be permitted at one time with a max weight of 450 pounds combined.

services.name: WHALES TAIL PARASAIL
services.desc: Beachside parasailing with a banana boat shuttle ride to and from the parasail boat. We offer a family-friendly, customer service-oriented operation with an emphasis on safety. Owned and operated by a former combat attack helicopter pilot so we proudly offer military discounts to our servicemembers. Can't wait for you to join our parasail family. Use SEASCAPE Beach Access close to the MAJESTIC SUN RESORT. Located behind WHALES SAIL THE TAIL! @ PARASAIL MIRAMAR BEACH!

includes: banana boat shuttle ride to and from the parasail boat
blurb: Parasailing with the only beach locations in the area. Family-friendly, professional crew with newest, well-maintained equipment. Parasail boats accommodate up to 12 passengers with USCG licensed captains and perfect safety records.
